title: TVSM Community Mod Registry
description: Community mod registry fetched by tvsm mod install/update/status. Hosted on GitHub Pages and cached locally at {modWorkDir}/.registry-cache.json with a configurable TTL (default: 60 minutes).

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last registry update.

name.description: Unique mod identifier. Used as the key in profiles and the store directory layout ({modWorkDir}/store/{name}/{version}/).

required.description: If true, installed without prompting during tvsm mod install --all.

recommended.description: If true, included in tvsm mod install --all alongside required mods.

url.description: Download URL for the mod archive (.zip).

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the downloaded archive, verified by tvsm before extraction.

installLayout.description: Required. How tvsm mod apply materialises this mod. A missing value is a validation error at registry parse time.

requires.description: Names of other registry mods that must be present before this one. tvsm resolves install order automatically.

gameVersionRange.description: Semver range string (e.g. '>=0.45', '>=0.45 <1.0'). Hard block at install if the detected game version is outside the range; warn-only at apply; suppressed by --force.
